description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - The Industrial Disputes between, Union of Magampura Port and Sri Lanka Ports Authority, Magampura Port Manegment Company (Privete) Limited
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers granted by that legislation. The content focuses on legal procedures and regulatory mechanisms for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
